ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the C1-2,

Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 5-F in
the area bound by:

West Armitage Avenue; a line 76.95 feet southeast of West Armitage Avenue as
measured along the east right-of-way line of North Lincoln Avenue; North Lincoln
Avenue,

to those of a B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

aa

Timothy R. Knudsen
Alderperson, 43 Ward

Common Address:
345 W. Armitage Avenue
